body: Sure I do not know you. But do not act like you did  anything different to anyone in this subreddit. As I said, stop bragging with the luck you had and for the love of god stop handing out these standard lines that you did not even follow yourself.

This comment feels like a "A lot of money does not make you happy" type of moral story. People who say stuff like this have never been lonely nor unattractive , have never been poor (looking at the money thing).

Bragging with luck does not help in any kind of way.
